simple.meaning: כָּתִית (kâthîyth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “beaten , i.e. pure (oil).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.

definitions.full: H3795. kathith כָּתִית adjective beaten ; — only in combination כָּתִית שֶׁמֶן beaten oil , i.e. oil made by beating or pounding the olives in a mortar; especially fine and costly (compare Levy NHWB ii. 443 below כָּתִית ); — 1 Kings 5:25; Exod 29:40 ; Num 28:5 ; כ זָךְ זַית ׳שֶׁמֶן לַמָּאוֺר Exod 27:20 pure beaten olive oil for the lamp = Lev 24:2 (Hexateuch only H, P).
